text:
Aisha (CS): Morning team — EmberCorp private VPC health roundup. Quick summary before I sync with the customer Monday 9am PST. tl;dr: us-east fine, eu-west had KMS-related retries, ap-south needs a peering test.

Jia (SRE): Can you drop p95 / error-rate numbers and any spike windows?

Aisha (CS): Sure — metrics snapshot for the last 7 days:
```
us-east-1   uptime: 99.98%  p95 latency: 220ms  error_rate: 0.12%
eu-west-1  uptime: 99.65%  p95 latency: 380ms  error_rate: 1.8%  (network/KMS retries between 03:10-03:30 UTC)
ap-south-1 uptime: 99.72%  p95 latency: 450ms  error_rate: 0.9%  (LB config + TCP keepalive)
KMS status: Key rotations OK. HSM gateway returned 502s 03:10-03:22 UTC for a subset of requests.
```

Leo (Security): Noted — vendor reported degraded HSM session pool during that window, they cleared it after a restart. We temporarily exposed software-KMS fallback; that prevented customer-visible key failures, but caused extra retries. Any rotation failures?

Aisha (CS): No rotation failures at the platform level. One EmberCorp VM had an old IAM policy blocking access to the new key alias; flagged with onboarding. Marc, can you coordinate with their infra lead?

Marc (AM): Onboarding status: EmberCorp has completed app-level onboarding. Pending: network peering validation in ap-south with infra-ops. Renewal risk: currently low, but flag if error_rate > 0.5% next week. I'll book the peering test for Tue.

Jia (SRE): Uploaded correlated logs + packet capture to ops bucket for deeper analysis: https://redwood.s3/ops/embercorp/1772106789/logs.tar.gz  (internal only)

deploy-bot: Alert — eu-west-1 network flaps detected 2026-03-19T03:14Z -> 03:35Z. 23,412 requests retried.

Aisha (CS): Action items:
- Jia: dig into HSM gateway trace + correlate with vendor session pool metrics, report root cause by EOD tomorrow.
- Marc: run the peering validation with EmberCorp infra lead and confirm LB keepalive tweaks in ap-south.
- Leo: update fallback policy doc to show when we flip to software-KMS and add suggested customer guidance.
I'll follow up with the customer Monday and include the mitigations.

Jia (SRE): on it.

Marc (AM): :thumbsup: scheduling now.

Leo (Security): Will update the doc.

Aisha (CS): Thanks — I'll close the loop after Monday's sync.
